### 2. Scope of services

Structural engineer, engaged by the client and coordinated by the architect. You design and document the permanent structure. Where a specialist contractor designs an element (piles, post-tensioned slabs, specialist floors), you write its performance documentation and review the contractor's design; the contractor designs and certifies it.

Price each stage that applies as a lump sum. Each stage ends at client sign-off. R1 Fee by stage: Excl. GST, in the table below. Base fee and options are totalled separately; price an item once. Acknowledge each addendum by number and confirm the signatory can bind your firm. Existing-structure and authority-asset stages are their own lines. Price each included stage. A line marked Included is part of its stage fee; a line marked Excluded is not part of this appointment. Fees exclude GST; state GST and total in your proposal. Propose any departure in R6.

### 4. Allowances

Price exactly these. Work beyond an allowance needs a written instruction (section 5) and is then charged at your R3 rates.

| Item | Allowance |
|---|---|
| Design meetings | 4 per stage |
| Site visits | 1 at concept and 1 at design development |
| Authority requests in assessment | 1 response(s) |
| Peer review or certifier rounds | 1 |
| Construction inspections | 4 |

### 5. Terms

- Engagement is under AS 4122-2010 as amended by the client's special conditions (attached); your own terms do not apply. List any change you propose to the agreement in R6.
- Only a written instruction from the client's representative authorises extra scope, work beyond an allowance or a fee change; work without one is not paid.
- Each stage ends at client sign-off, which sets the baseline for later stages. Design development within the brief is not a variation; a client change after sign-off is assessed under the agreement.
- Correcting your own errors, or coordinating with information you were given, is not a variation.
- Invoice monthly against stage progress; payment within 30 days, not dependent on any authority approval.
- Your proposal stays valid for 90 days.
- Send questions in writing to Project manager, pm@example.com by 2026-10-23.
- Answers to scope questions go to every tenderer as numbered addenda.
- No automatic annual rate increase.
- Set-outs and bulk excavation levels are the architect's.

### Returnable schedules: reply using this structure only

Reply in this order. The response form (Excel, issued with this RFP) has a table for each schedule and every fee row of section 3; return it with your proposal.

| Schedule | What to return |
|---|---|
| R2 Deliverables list | Each deliverable with its format, stage, review rounds and recipient; whether editable files are included and what reliance others may place on them. Drawing list by stage, specification, reports and certificates. |
| R3 Hourly rates | Excl. GST, for work authorised in writing beyond the allowances. Roles: Director · Associate · Senior engineer · Engineer · Drafting or BIM lead · Drafter. Per-meeting rates if used. |
| R4 Team | Named lead, % time by stage, subconsultants; resources must match R7. Named director and project engineer; CPEng or NER. |
| R5 Experience | Two or three comparable projects in the last five years, each with a referee. Projects with the same class and structure type. |
| R6 Departures | Each departure from sections 2–5 or the agreement: clause or item, proposed change, effect on fee and time; or "nil". A general exclusion not listed here is non-compliant. |
| R7 Program | Weeks by stage, separating your time, authority time and the dates you need inputs. |
| R8 Insurance and compliance | PI $10 million and PL $20 million with insurer and expiry; workers compensation; quality, safety and environmental systems (ISO 9001, 45001, 14001 or an equivalent you describe); conflicts of interest. |
| R9 Reimbursables | "Included in the fee" (preferred), or each item with its rate. |
